cohort: Pregnant patients diagnosed with Chiari malformation, stratified by race (Black and White).
finding: White patients with Arnold-Chiari malformation had a significantly increased risk of preeclampsia following cesarean delivery, while Black patients experienced significantly more perineal lacerations with vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a significantly lower risk of preeclampsia in White patients compared to cesarean delivery, but also with significantly more perineal lacerations in Black patients.
